title: Input-aligned structure preservation at a matched rewiring budget
status: Prospectively specified exploratory follow-up to inspected prior experiments; no independent preregistration
source: Frozen prior E3 homogeneous seed 99; inherited raw_sum/canonical-order patches; only new driver input targets

treatments.A_degree: Per-node per-E/I-arm in/out degree and strength preserved
treatments.B_aligned: A plus per-node incoming/outgoing strength for each of 10 declared E/I subgroups
treatments.C_random: Same constraints as B for a fixed randomly relabelled, equally sized, E/I-respecting partition

partitions.interpretation: Five declared stimulus-aligned subdivisions per E/I class, not discovered communities or physical space

changed_edge_budget: Exactly floor(0.35*M_arm) missing original endpoint pairs per projection arm in every treatment; source rows, weight bits and delays unchanged
sampler: First hit of fixed adjacency-change target, bounded proposals; not uniform null sampling. Cannot match all feasible-set geometry/acceptance rates.

shifted_burst.purpose: Held-out stimulus location for rank transfer; no reselection

focal_burst.purpose: Prespecified cross-group stress probe; no reselection

stimulus: All three stimulate exactly 20 E chunks at strength 150 for 80 slots; 220 recovery slots
primary_score: Explicit rewired vs original explicit: sqrt(mean squared difference across time/chunks/V,gE,gI after channel-wise normalization by original reference SD across time/chunks); all 300 slots. Smaller is better. Reference-specific scaling reported.
secondary: chunk and population 1 ms spike L1
rankings: Select best/median/worst and top/bottom five using module_burst score only; keep graph identities on shifted/focal tests. Report all 15 graphs. No p-values.
morphology: joint E/I leading singular subspaces; diagnostic not simulator Jacobian
morphology_scope: Associations on 15 dependent conditional surrogates; pooled treatment confounding explicitly reported. No biological or universal-best shape inference.
common_input: Five predetermined levels of independently time-shifted source rows on an otherwise group-synchronous binary 0/100 raster; same source raster on each graph. Exact binary32 weights evaluated in float64. Identity checks do not prove closed-loop trajectory preservation.
pca: Fixed rank-5 linear state subspace fitted only to original explicit module_burst; same basis/scales for all graphs and probes; descriptive, not nonlinear manifold inference
hypotheses: B eliminates common-input error for exactly group-uniform sources
Increasing within-group residual need not monotonically increase error
B may or may not reduce closed-loop state error vs A/C; comparison remains conditional
Best graph on one stimulus need not transfer
costs: All edges/states retained. No pruning, compression, speedup or global memory-capacity claim.
exclusions: No preprint changes until results reviewed; no new FlyWire data, new memory tuning or broad topology sweep
